title: ReStage：可再执行的演出空间
summary: 研究如何把一次现场视听演出保存为可测量、可重建、可编辑、可再次执行的空间状态，并以开放的 OPS 数据层连接 Web、Unity、Apple Vision Pro 与 AI Agent。
summaryEn: A long-term research project on preserving live audiovisual performance as a measurable, reconstructable and re-executable spatial state shared across Web, Unity, Apple Vision Pro and AI agents.
